decisions.reason: The flat $10 secondary-sale royalty does not change which NFT entitlements, identity, badges, or expired tickets transfer to the purchaser.
The secondary-sale royalty amount and type do not alter the unlimited-mint NFT ebook collection model.
The royalty decision does not change the specified ticket counters, badges, or referral-code attribute in NFT metadata.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already records that secondary sales carry a clearly displayed flat $10 royalty, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Setting a flat $10 secondary-sale royalty leaves the Big Block prize parameters and the existing fact that secondary royalties fund the pool unchanged; no allocation amount is specified.
Setting a flat $10 secondary-sale royalty leaves the Small Block prize parameters and the existing fact that secondary sales fund the pool unchanged; no allocation amount is specified.
The royalty amount and type do not change the manual one-click prize claim flow or its Winners-page location.
The flat secondary-sale royalty is independent of the $5 commission triggered by a primary mint using a referral code.
This candidate describes primary-mint pricing and allocation; the secondary-sale royalty amount and type do not change its current primary-sale attributes.
The secondary-sale royalty decision does not change code-used primary-mint ticket issuance, and secondary sales remain non-ticket-generating.
The secondary-sale royalty amount and type do not affect referral badge milestones or on-chain badge recording.
The royalty parameters do not alter the requirement to deploy the product on the Base Ethereum L2 network.
